# Custom Agents

This file lists custom agents available for this repository.

- `python-senior-developer` — Use when reviewing or modifying Python backend code, designing architecture, improving tests, or mentoring through code changes in this repo.
- `product-owner` — Use when defining product scope, user stories, acceptance criteria, and user-facing requirements for the Family Timer app.
- `repo-guide` — Use when you need a quick overview of the Family Timer repository, architecture, or run/test conventions.
